factors.label: Flood risk
factors.good: Rarely flooded ground: little risk of physical damage.
factors.bad: Frequently flooded ground: physical damage risk. Flood history outweighs sunshine.

factors.label: Solar irradiance
factors.good: Strong irradiance: more generation per panel.

factors.label: Land use
factors.good: Open land with little conflict with farming.
factors.bad: Land that is costly to convert or better kept as farmland.

factors.label: Roads and grid
factors.good: Close to roads and power lines: easy to install and maintain.
factors.bad: Far from roads and power lines: costly to connect and service.

factors.label: Terrain
factors.bad: Steeper terrain: harder and costlier to build on.

factors.label: Drought
factors.bad: Recurring drought zone: looks open and sunny, but heat stress, no cleaning water and fire exposure.

roof_factors.label: Flood risk
roof_factors.good: Dry ground around the building: equipment and access stay safe.
roof_factors.bad: Flood-prone location: inverters and access are at risk.

roof_factors.label: Roof sunlight
roof_factors.good: Well-lit roof: little shade and a good orientation.
roof_factors.bad: Shaded or poorly oriented roof: much less sunlight on the panels.

roof_factors.label: Roof size
roof_factors.good: A large usable roof: one installation, lower cost per kW.
roof_factors.bad: Little usable space: small, costly installations.

roof_factors.label: On-site demand
roof_factors.good: A tall building uses what its roof produces.
roof_factors.bad: A low building exports most of what it produces.

roof_excl_names: on roofs without enough clear, sunlit space
